title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Psalms 27: Yahweh as light and salvation, the one thing asked of him, and waiting for Yahweh with courage.

questions.text: Besides his light, what does the psalmist call Yahweh in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 27:1 says, 'Yahweh is my light and my salvation.'

questions.text: What happened to the evildoers who came to eat up the psalmist's flesh?
What does the psalmist say about his heart if an army encamps against him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 27:3 says, 'Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear.'

questions.text: What is the one thing the psalmist has asked of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he asked that he may dwell in Yahweh's house all the days of his life.

answers.text: To see all his enemies destroyed before him
To dwell in Yahweh's house all the days of his life
To rule over the nations around him
To have many sons and daughters in his house

questions.text: On what will Yahweh lift the psalmist up in the day of trouble?
questions.explanation: Psalms 27:5 says, 'He will lift me up on a rock.'

questions.text: What kind of sacrifices will the psalmist offer in Yahweh's tent?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent.'

questions.text: When Yahweh said, 'Seek my face,' what did the psalmist's heart answer?
questions.explanation: Psalms 27:8 says his heart said, 'I will seek your face, Yahweh.'

questions.text: What will happen when the psalmist's father and mother forsake him?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, 'When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.'

answers.text: His brothers will take him in
He will go to a far country

questions.text: Where is the psalmist confident he will see the goodness of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 27:13 says, 'I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.'

answers.text: In the house of his fathers
In the city of the king
In the land of the living

questions.text: Which instruction appears twice in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says, 'Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.'
